title.narrative: Projet AZIR Oriental : Appui à l#amélioration de la compétitivité de la chaine de valeur du romarin dans l#Oriental

description.narrative: The project AZIR-O aims at increasing the participation of the local populations in the economic development through systemic change in market relations, acting as a catalyst to analyze and identify solutions for the main obstacles to market development and its local impact. The ultimate goal of the project is to significantly strengthen the links of the rosemary value chain, especially those benefiting cooperatives, to ensure the sustainable management of the local resources and a greater participation of the local population in the value addition targeting the natural resource.
